items.summaryZh: 白宫举行了此次会议，背景是一些科技巨头和专家呼吁对人工智能实施更严格的监管。会议探讨了人工智能发展的未来方向与政策框架。
items.whyImportant: 此次峰会反映了美国政府在人工智能监管与技术竞争之间寻求平衡的政策动向。

items.title: Ex-American Idol singer Caleb Flynn convicted of fatally shooting his wife
items.summary: A former Ohio music pastor who once appeared on American Idol was convicted of murder on Tuesday in the killing of his wife while he was having an affair. Prosecutors said Caleb Flynn, 40, staged a home invasion in February after shooting his wife, Ashley Flynn, a 37-year-old teacher and volleyball coach. items.titleZh: 前《美国偶像》歌手凯莱布·弗林因枪杀妻子被定罪
items.summaryZh: 前俄亥俄州音乐牧师、曾参加《美国偶像》的凯莱布·弗林因枪杀妻子被判谋杀罪。检方指出，弗林在婚外情期间策划了这起入室抢劫假象，他可能面临终身监禁且不得假释。
items.whyImportant: 此案因被告的公众人物身份及其犯罪手段的残忍性引发了广泛的社会关注。

items.title: Pentagon picks Boeing to build new carrier fighter jet to replace F/A-18
items.summary: The Pentagon has chosen Boeing to build the US Navy’s next-generation fighter jets in a contract valued at US$20 billion, officials announced Tuesday. The contract is to produce F/A-XX aircraft or “strike fighters” under the “Next Generation Air Dominance Program,” a Pentagon statement said, adding that the new jets would replace the legacy Super Hornets fleet beginning in the 2030s. items.titleZh: 五角大楼选择波音公司建造新型航母战斗机以取代F/A-18
items.summaryZh: 五角大楼宣布授予波音公司一份价值200亿美元的合同，用于研发下一代“F/A-XX”战斗机。这些新型战机预计将在2030年代起逐步取代现役的超级大黄蜂机队。
items.whyImportant: 此举标志着美国海军航空力量现代化进程的重要一步，并巩固了波音在国防工业中的核心地位。

items.title: Florida man, age 77, becomes 16th person to be executed in state this year
items.summary: Curtis Wilkie Beasley executed for 1995 killing of Carolyn Monfort, after US supreme court declines to intervene A 77-year-old Florida man was put to death on Tuesday for his conviction in a deadly hammer attack on a woman decades ago, becoming the 16th person executed this year in the nation’s busiest death chamber. Curtis Wilkie Beasley was pronounced dead at 6.12pm following a lethal injection at the Florida state prison near Starke, authorities said. He was convicted of first-degree murder, robbery and grand theft auto in the 1995 hammer attack on Carolyn Monfort at her home south of Orlando. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 佛罗里达州77岁男子被执行死刑，为该州今年第16名死刑犯
items.summaryZh: 77岁的柯蒂斯·威尔基·比斯利因1995年的一起锤击杀人案被执行死刑。在最高法院拒绝干预后，他成为佛罗里达州今年执行死刑的第16人。
items.whyImportant: 此案再次引发了关于死刑执行频率及司法公正性的讨论。
